frame: origin hood rear-right corner, paper/top surface; +X forward (toward crossbar), +Y toward car left, +Z hood-plane normal up (not gravity-referenced)

scale.source: user statement: four squares per linear inch
scale.corroboration: hood length counts 44.01 cells = 279.5 mm; equals 11.00 in (US-letter long side) - consistency check, not independent proof
scale.reconstruction_scale_source: hood outline (grid mm) fitted to IMG_2740 with RealityKit pose and EXIF 24 mm-equivalent focal length

thickness_source: design assumption carried from earlier agreement (3 mm); paper template has no thickness

hood.type: planar panel, paper = top surface, solid extends -Z by 3 mm

evidence.length: grid cells edge-to-edge in IMG_2740, 11 clean strips median 44.012 cells (all 19: median 44.006, range 42.73-44.36); 8/19 strips had peak-gap anomalies and were excluded
evidence.width: 19 strips, 27.05-27.49 cells; linear fit rear 27.079 / front 27.421 cells, residual RMS 0.039 cells; 0/19 strips anomalous
evidence.planarity: RealityKit point cloud paper cluster thickness (1 sigma) 0.006 units = 1.2 mm
evidence.held_out: outline projected into IMG_2741, IMG_2742 (not used in fit) and video frames lands on paper edges (deliverables/overlays/). Video focal length is not constant: top-down segment fits ~3000 px, driver-seat segment 3300 px

provenance.Y=0 right edge straight: observed edge; taper (2.2 mm) assigned to the Y=w left edge = design choice (width counts cannot locate it)
provenance.rear/front edges: observed edges, parallel to grid within count noise

cheek.type: planar side panel hanging below the hood right edge; separate paper piece taped under hood (its own printed logo); paper = outboard face, solid extends +Y (inboard) 3 mm
cheek.hole_note: triangular cutout with rounded corners; vertices observed in 5 views; corner radius 1.5 mm = design estimate

triangulation.rejected_before_fit: 1 of 33 clicked observations (v_0110 inboard point: identity inconsistent, 74 mm off plane) = 3.0%

cheek.joint: cheek top edge extended to Z=-1.5 (1.5 mm into the 3 mm hood) so the joined model fuses; labelled design overlap, not measured
